<!-- Source page: Grafana Loki -->

**[Grafana Loki](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/)** is a log aggregation system. *"Like <a href="Prometheus" class="wikilink" title="Prometheus">Prometheus</a>, but for logs."*

## Usage

You can configure Loki with , and pass settings with either a YAML file in `configFile`, or a Nix attribute set in `configuration`.
